answer: Anti-sybil via a cipher-locked challenge bond: each agent embeds the epoch seed into a short cipher commitment before any work pays. An attacker must fund N cipher bonds and operate N independent minds across distinct basalt paths to mint N plumes; batch scripting cannot fake the live path diversity.
